faq: Do you reply as if you were the business?
Yes, as your team, in your approved voice, with a signature or first name if you want. We never pretend to be a customer, and we do not post fake comments or reviews.
What happens with complaints or refunds?
We acknowledge them politely, then flag them to you in the same day. We do not offer refunds or make promises about orders unless you give us a rule for it.
Does this need access to my direct messages?
Yes, through the platform's own inbox access that you grant to us. We do not ask for passwords, and we do not copy private messages outside your accounts.
It is a one-week sprint with a library to keep going. Daily or monthly management is quoted separately, so ask for a written quote if you want it long term.

desc:
Social media comment and message replies keep your warmest audience from feeling ignored. Ecom Swift LLC answers questions and thanks people in your own accounts, in your brand voice, and leaves you with a saved reply library your team can keep using.

## Why unanswered comments cost you customers

Every comment and direct message is a person who already paid attention to you. They asked about a size, a price, a delivery date or a feature, and they are deciding whether you are worth the trouble. If nobody answers, they usually do not ask twice. They move on to a competitor who replied the same day.

Silence is also visible. Other visitors read the comment thread under a post, and a question with no answer tells them the business is not paying attention. A quick, friendly reply does the opposite, because it shows that a real person is behind the page.

## What are social media comment and message replies?

Social media comment and message replies are the answers a business gives to public comments and private messages on its channels, such as Instagram, Facebook or TikTok. They cover product questions, thanks, order queries and complaints. Done well, they work as customer service and as quiet sales support at the same time.

## How replies affect sales and loyalty

A reply removes the doubt that stops a purchase. When a shopper learns that a jacket runs small or that shipping reaches their country, the main obstacle disappears right where they were looking. Replies also encourage more comments, because people join conversations that get answered.

Replies influence loyalty too. A customer who gets a thoughtful answer to a problem often remembers the brand more kindly than one who never had a problem. We cannot promise a particular number of sales, because results depend on your products and prices. What we can do is make sure good opportunities are not missed.

## What good replies look like

- Written in your voice, using a style guide we agree with you first.
- Fast enough that the person is still interested.
- Specific to the question, not a copy-pasted line.
- Short, friendly and free of jargon.
- Clear about the next step, such as a link, an email address or a store page.
- Careful with prices, stock and delivery claims, which must match what you actually offer.
- Quick to move private details, such as order numbers, into a direct message.
- Calm with criticism, never defensive and never argumentative.
- Ready to flag anything that needs the owner, such as refunds or legal threats.
- Recorded in a reply library so the best answers are saved.

## What we do

We begin by agreeing a short voice and tone guide, plus a list of topics we may answer and topics we must pass to you. Then we spend the agreed days working through comments and messages on your channels, answering questions, thanking people and hiding spam where the platform allows it. Complaints, refund requests and unusual cases go on an escalation list for you instead of being improvised.

Across the Basic, Standard and Premium packages, the difference is the number of channels, the length of coverage and the extras. The larger options add a reply library of saved answers, a weekly summary of common questions and a handover call. You see what customers keep asking, which is often useful for product pages and FAQs.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us your return, shipping and stock rules before we start.
- Share any wording you prefer or dislike.
- Decide in advance who handles complaints.
- Read the summary of questions and update your product pages.
- Keep using the reply library after the week ends.

**Avoid:**
- Asking us to promise things you cannot deliver.
- Arguing with critics in public threads.
- Replying to every comment with the same sentence.
- Sharing personal customer details in a public reply.
- Treating this week as a replacement for ongoing community management.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store owner who spends launch weeks answering messages instead of running the business. It suits a brand that just had a busy post or a small viral moment and has hundreds of comments waiting. It also suits a team that wants to see what good replies sound like before writing its own routine.

## What we need from you

We need access to the channels we will cover, given as an admin, editor, moderator or similar role where the platform allows it. We never need passwords. Please send your voice notes, your policies for shipping and returns, and any answers you already use. If direct messages are included in your package, tell us which message folders are allowed. Anything outside the agreed rules is passed to you before we reply.
